segments.name: Cement
segments.description: Manufactures limestone cement and slag cement at plants and terminals, selling to construction customers building infrastructure, nonresidential and residential projects.
segments.evidence: the mining of limestone for the manufacture, production, distribution, and sale of cement, including limestone cement (a basic construction material that is the essential binding ingredient in concrete)

segments.name: Concrete and Aggregates
segments.description: Mines aggregates and sells readymix concrete to building contractors and other customers for public infrastructure, private nonresidential and residential construction.
segments.evidence: the sale of readymix concrete; and the mining and sale of aggregates (crushed stone, sand, and gravel).

segments.name: Gypsum Wallboard
segments.description: Manufactures gypsum wallboard under the American Gypsum name for building-materials dealers, distributors and home-center chains serving residential construction.
segments.evidence: Our gypsum wallboard products are marketed under the name American Gypsum.

segments.name: Recycled Paperboard
segments.description: Manufactures recycled paperboard, principally gypsum liner, and sells it to gypsum wallboard manufacturers and other industrial paperboard converters.
segments.evidence: Although the machine was designed primarily to manufacture gypsum liner products, we are also able to manufacture several alternative products, including containerboard grades and lightweight packaging grades.

revenueModel.text: Construction contractors, building-materials dealers, distributors and manufacturers buy cement, aggregates, readymix concrete, wallboard and paperboard from the company's plants and distribution network.
revenueModel.evidence: Eagle manufactures and sells its products through a network of more than 70 facilities spanning 21 states.
